chapterTitle: 02 Natural Vegetation and Forests of Pakistan
learnerTitle: Map Pakistan’s forests and their benefits
title: Utilize geographic tools and techniques to annotate and map the spatial distribution of the different types of forests in Pakistan, including productive and protective forests, and also elaborate their benefits and uses for the country.

chapterTitle: 02 Natural Vegetation and Forests of Pakistan
learnerTitle: Compare plantations and mangroves for sustainability
title: Investigate different factors affecting the different types of forests and evaluate the advantages and disadvantages of irrigated plantations and mangroves with regards to sustainability and climatic impacts and protecting against natural disasters.

chapterTitle: 02 Natural Vegetation and Forests of Pakistan
title: Differentiate between deforestation and afforestation while critically analyzing the causes and effects of deforestation on climate and social life in Pakistan, and propose sustainable solutions to address deforestation
